entries.text: a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
`assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent
the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`)
a one-line stderr warning to `claude -p` text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends
`--continue` sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314)
macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew
permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared

`/logout`, `claude auth logout` and `claude mcp remove` reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory
jobs exiting with `Not logged in` when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home
`claude mcp add` and `remove` writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a saved server
`claude plugin` commands exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
`claude plugin validate` passing a custom-named marketplace file that `claude plugin marketplace add` rejects
stdio MCP servers that exit on the version probe being re-probed on every start; a server that dies in under 3s for its own reason is also pinned to the legacy handshake for 7 days
sessions being refused at startup by an `allowedProviders` list that another login on the same machine had stored
idle compaction replacing a conversation with a reply that was not a summary
the "Now using usage credits" notice reappearing about every 30 seconds while a background subagent is running
custom slash commands that fail, or that only Claude can invoke, printing nothing in `claude -p` and SDK sessions
`claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions reporting success when an API error cut off a reply while a mod hooked `turn.step`
a message sent right after a model change still running after Stop in headless sessions: Stop now cancels or stops it as it would a queued message
a deleted session transcript being re-created with its last prompt when an idle non-interactive session exited

`claude remote-control` hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (`spawn ENOENT`) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process
a running Claude Code process owned by another user (for example one left by `sudo claude`) being treated as dead by version cleanup, which could delete its binary
`/remote-control` showing a session as available after a failed connection
`/design revoke` reporting success when the request failed with a 404
a shell command approved after a self-hosted runner or cloud session restart running in the session's start folder, not the folder it was asked in; if that folder can't be entered, it is not run
Claude not being told when an approved connector tool was unavailable after a cloud session restart
cloud sessions being stopped in the middle of a turn when the service refuses uploads for several minutes
variables a `Setup` hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool in some cloud sessions
the iPhone app showing a cloud session's turn as finished while it kept running, after a response was cut off at a tool call or a refused image or document was removed
a restarted session re-sending a message that failed with an API error, ahead of the newer message waiting behind it
a restarted session dropping its interrupted turn when the restart came right after Claude read a large image or retried a tool call
every connection failing when the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file is empty, not PEM, or starts with a damaged certificate: readable certificates are now used, with a warning on stderr
workflows re-running finished agents when resumed after a usage limit
`/mcp` in cloud sessions counting tools the model can't use; a server's row now shows how many of its tools are available
a duplicate notification when Claude left the status field out of a PushNotification call
the error for a too-large image in a request with more than 20 images always saying the limit was 2000px; it now shows the API's limit
the runtime in background shell details not updating while the dialog is open
a mod's `turn.step` hook making a stopped reply finish as a success in headless runs
retention cleanup leaving a home that only runs `claude -p` with no `~/.claude.json` backup: it now takes a fresh backup before deleting the last good one
the stored login being replaced by an empty file when a network home directory has no room left for data but still takes new files
tokens from `setup-token` being refused at start on machines with `forceLoginOrgUUID`, when the token belongs to a permitted organization
non-interactive launches replacing a `~/.claude.json` that isn't valid JSON with defaults; the start now fails, says how to restore the file, and leaves it as is (anthropics/claude-code#87551)
an empty `~/.claude.json` with no backup being reported as corrupted; Claude Code now starts as it does when the file is missing
the restore command printed for a damaged or missing `~/.claude.json` naming an empty or cut-off backup, or failing on a read-only file
the sign-in failure when a stored claude.ai login reaches its time limit: it now says so, and in `claude -p` names `claude auth login` and `claude setup-token`

Improved how `~/.claude.json`, settings files and the stored login survive saves on shared network home directories: they are less often deleted, briefly emptied or replaced by a near-empty or older copy
Improved sessions on network file systems to look again when the configuration file is wrongly reported as missing, so fewer start without your MCP servers and trusted folders
Improved MCP tool errors: a call made before the tool is loaded now returns its input schema
Improved the reliability of git commits and pull request creation when the Bash tool runs macOS's built-in `/bin/bash`
Improved "Ask your admin for more usage" in the usage limit menu to send the request in one step
Improved how fast remote sessions reconnect after a pause or sleep
Improved You should know toasts to say "try again" instead of "press 2", which only works in the terminal
Improved auto-update reliability: a brief network failure while verifying a release is now retried right away instead of waiting for the next check
Improved unattended runs (`claude -p`, SDK apps) to stop rewriting `~/.claude.json` on every run when nothing in it changed
Claude Code to no longer install or update the IDE extension when started in an IDE terminal; use `/ide` from an outside terminal or your editor's extensions view
subagents to stop instead of switching models when "Switch models when a message is flagged" is set to "Ask each time"
background subagents to move a shell command to the background after 3 minutes on all providers, so the prompt cache doesn't expire while it runs
subagent progress summaries on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry off: on a cold prompt cache, one can now wait up to 5 minutes for the subagent's pending response
what a mod attaches at `prompt.submit` to stay in the user's turn rather than go out as a system message

`deniedMcpServers` URL entries to also block Anthropic-provided servers whose upstream URL matches, and connectors in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners, where the session is given the connector's own URL; otherwise deny a connector by name
the `/permissions` rule details, built-in rules and delete confirmation views to use the standard dialog; pressing Ctrl+C twice there now goes back or cancels instead of quitting

`/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` to give a new agent's built-in tools, and a quickstart template's MCP tools, the `auto` permission policy ("Judge risky actions") by default, matching the Claude Console; say "run without asking" to opt out
Removed the 2.1.288 fix that kept the model's earlier thinking when resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier; that thinking can now be dropped
Gateway: Added a log warning when the Google access token from a federation (`external_account`) credentials file is about to expire
Gateway: Improved the log hints about `listen.trusted_proxies`: they now say to list only a proxy that adds the connecting address to `X-Forwarded-For` itself
Gateway: Improved the warning when AWS CountTokens fails on Amazon Bedrock: it says Claude Code, not the gateway, counts after the 501, and points at IAM only when AWS denies access
Self-hosted runner: Added `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON` to the orchestrator's spawn-runner hook environment: why Anthropic sent the request (e.g. `runner_lost`, `resumed`); unset when none was sent
Self-hosted runner: Added a startup warning when `--release-idle-session-min` is the last argument with no value (still ignored) or has a value of only spaces (still read as `0`)

Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator's log lines: `ok session=…` now prints at every log level on stdout (was debug only, stderr) with `reason=…` after `jti=…`, and `nack session=…` ends its fields with `reason=…` after `retryable=…`; update scripts that match `retryable=true:` or `retryable=false:`
Remote Control: Fixed a misleading "spawn error: ENOENT" when a session's working folder is missing; the error now names the folder
Remote Control: Improved the title a fork of a terminal fork is created with when the app doesn't set one: "Name (fork 2)"
[VSCode] Fixed a window whose sign-in the organization's settings refuse starting a new Claude Code process in the background every minute
[VSCode] Fixed a long word in the chat panel's error banner pushing its close button out of view
[VSCode] Improved the sign-in screen to show what Claude Code printed when its sign-in status check fails
[Cloud sessions] Added a No repository option: a cloud session on an Anthropic-hosted environment can now start without picking a repository
[Cloud sessions] Added the usual Chrome names to cloud sessions, so tools other than Playwright can find the built-in Chromium through google-chrome and CHROME_PATH
[Cloud sessions] Added a New session button to the card shown when a cloud session's environment was deleted, where the message box is hidden
[Cloud sessions] Fixed reading GitHub Actions logs in cloud sessions: `gh run view --log` and `gh api` log requests now get the log in most environments, not an unreachable redirect
[Cloud sessions] Improved most Create PR failure messages in cloud and Remote Control sessions: they now give the reason or a link to GitHub instead of saying Try again
[Cloud sessions] Changed connector search results to tell Claude that the search covers only part of the connector directory
[Remote Control] Fixed side-by-side checkouts of one repository looking identical in the environment menu's Remote Control rows; each now shows its own folder name
[Claude Tag] Fixed keyboard focus and screen reader announcements in Claude Tag admin setup; pressing Escape in the connect form no longer also closes the Add dialog
[Code Review] Improved the Code Review analytics page to retry once after a server or network failure, then show a Try again banner instead of empty cards
a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network
`onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run
a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view
`anthropic.plan`, `anthropic.seat_type`, `anthropic.provider` and `anthropic.custom_base_url` to OTel metrics, events and spans
a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group
a daily record of each developer's IdP groups on Claude apps gateways with `admin:` set, kept for `admin.identity_retention_days`, which the cost report groups by
`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`: set it to `1` on a self-hosted runner to have `claude -p` run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions
project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions
auto mode failing every turn when an LLM gateway set as the base URL answers 403 or 422 to its server-side safety check (a 403 with an apiKeyHelper is unchanged)
`claude auth status` exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
a project's `effortLevel` setting being ignored by sessions that an app starts ahead of time and then opens in the project, such as new sessions in the desktop app's Code tab
`claude --from-pr` reporting "No conversations found" in projects with many sessions when the linked session was older than the first page
the second of two simultaneous permission prompts showing no file path or command on claude.ai and the mobile apps
Remote Control and SDK hosts offering "don't ask again" on a mod's tool calls
session titles being lost in cloud and SDK sessions when a new message or Stop arrived while the title was generating
self-paced `/loop` wakeups sometimes not being scheduled when Claude left a field out of its request
auto mode in cloud sessions stopping for approval when the Artifact tool uploaded, wrote to a database or saved a file through the outputs folder
skills synced from claude.ai being lost or downloaded again every ten minutes when they can't be written to disk
`/schedule` leaving a cloud scheduled task's next run time and link out of its results after creating or updating it
screen readers speaking a running subagent's elapsed time and token count on every change in screen reader mode
a region or network block (HTTP 403) being shown as a sign-in failure; the error now explains the block
Claude saying a working claude.ai connector needed authorization or had failed in cloud sessions when a synced plugin included the same server
`claude -p` exiting 0 when a full disk or quota lost its transcript or ~/.claude.json writes; it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1. Full NFS exports may be missed
edits to settings files made in the first second or so after launch not taking effect until a settings file changed again
old transcripts not being cleaned up on machines where some runs skip cleanup, such as runs using `--setting-sources`
deleted agent team inboxes being re-created by a teammate's late message
a re-created agent teammate being removed from its team by an earlier shutdown approval
stored scheduled tasks being impossible to list or delete after scheduled tasks were turned off
Claude deleting your most recently updated `/team-onboarding` guide when asked to delete one without naming which
Claude saying a `/team-onboarding` guide was deleted when the server refused the delete
the Claude apps gateway hiding Amazon Bedrock's "Input is too long." error, which left sessions failing every turn with "upstream rejected the request" instead of compacting
self-hosted runner sessions losing recent turns or the whole conversation when restarted while a plan waited for approval
"Prompt is too long" after automatic compaction in sessions whose very large CLAUDE.md changed since it was last sent
high memory use and slow startup in headless sessions with many plugins that register commands
stdio MCP servers receiving an empty `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` when their env config sets it to empty; the variable is now unset, so the server can use the machine's own AWS credentials
API requests failing with "unable to get local issuer certificate" behind some TLS-inspecting proxies after a root certificate renewal
very long conversations losing their earlier summary when compaction had to shorten its own request
a PDF's own metadata being able to make Read and @-mentions under-count its pages
`DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS` and `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET` having no effect on `[1m]`, other-region and undated spellings of the default model
`/artifacts` and the Artifact tool's shared list showing no shared artifacts when you have 200 or more of your own
Claude treating partial Grep and Glob results as complete when a search hit its time limit
OpenTelemetry exports to an `https://` endpoint through a proxy never being sent when they started while another export was still in progress
a flood of connection attempts to a proxy that blocks (HTTP 403) OpenTelemetry exports to an `http://` endpoint
OpenTelemetry exports hanging indefinitely behind a proxy that never answers; they now time out after 10 seconds, or `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` up to 30 seconds
resumed sessions telling Claude again about a file change it already knew about
Claude sometimes not using a built-in tool in a resumed session after an earlier call failed because the tool was switched off
`/remote-control` answering "Unknown command" instead of saying that Remote Control is turned off by the `disableRemoteControl` setting
agent team teammates in tmux or iTerm2 panes starting in auto mode when the lead session was in manual mode
a background session sometimes losing a just-made change of permission mode when it was upgraded or retired
Ctrl+C stopping all running background agents when pressed to clear typed text at the prompt
/feedback showing "Enter to confirm" while a report is being sent
child processes of a stopped shell command sometimes being sent SIGTERM twice, which could make some programs skip their cleanup
`claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session sharing that session's ID: it wrote into the session's transcript, and a restart could resume the wrong conversation
`claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session generating a title of its own and sending it to that session
Improved the error shown on Microsoft Foundry when Azure credentials can't be loaded: it now says to check or refresh them, and reports as `cloud_credential_error`
Improved `/design-sync` to say up front when your design system has moved to Claude, and stop before building instead of failing at upload
Improved the startup error when a required Claude apps gateway can't be reached: it points to the network instead of a sign-in, and says when the gateway's TLS certificate can't be verified
Improved the "Resume this session with" hint shown at exit to repeat the flags you launched with (for example `--chrome --debug`) ahead of `--resume`
Improved how self-hosted runners recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a runner's next poll now opens a new connection instead of reusing the one that failed
Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a session now opens new connections instead of reusing the one that failed
Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover when connections stop answering: after a heartbeat gets no answer, a session now opens new connections instead of trying each idle one in turn
SendMessage so a message to a running background agent arrives earlier: its running command moves to the background, without being stopped
subagents and teammates on a different model from the main conversation to use that model's saved effort level or its default, instead of the session's effort level
exit to skip the "Background work is running" prompt for plugin monitors
the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill to offer once, after a mod you built works, to help share the mod
Removed the Read tool's "file unchanged since your last Read" stub: reading an unchanged file again returns its content
Windows: Fixed every tool call being refused on some volumes where the native path lookup fails; the working-directory check now compares the folder's identity instead

Windows: Fixed the session scratchpad and other temporary paths growing with your project's path length in sessions not started by Claude Desktop, which made repositories cloned into them hit the 260-character path limit
Gateway: Fixed the status line and `/usage` showing a developer's own spend limit as 100% used after their group's pooled budget ran out
Self-hosted runner: Fixed Claude not seeing the interrupted tool call when a session moves to a new runner and the turn is older than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS`
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server that was switched off coming back on after the session moved to a new machine, when the session service had refused to save the switch

Remote Control: Improved fork names when the app doesn't set one: a long name keeps its "(fork)" ending, and in sessions started with `claude remote-control` a fork of "Name (fork)" is "Name (fork 2)"

[VSCode] Fixed forked conversations dropping messages: only one of the tool calls Claude ran in parallel was kept, and the last messages a compaction kept were lost, which could leave Claude's answer without the question it answered
[VSCode] Fixed a message being lost when Claude did not finish starting in time: the extension now starts Claude once more before showing the error
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen opening when a request is blocked for its region or network
[VSCode] Fixed the Account panel showing the plan name with a lower-cased second word
[VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening on top of the chat instead of in another editor group
[VSCode] Fixed attachment chips, menus, banners and dialogs in the Claude panel staying small when `chat.fontSize` is raised
[VSCode] Fixed `ultrathink` not raising effort for its turn or showing its rainbow when telemetry is off
[Cloud sessions] Added a link card to cloud sessions, so you can open or decline a link an MCP server asks you to visit instead of the request going unseen
[Cloud sessions] Changed the organization environment dialog in admin settings to the personal dialogs' short layout: each section opens from a row, and unsaved input asks before closing
[Cloud sessions] Fixed adding a network secret for a host that already has one silently replacing it; the Add secret form now refuses and points you to the existing secret
[Cloud sessions] Fixed new scheduled tasks ignoring your organization's default environment: the form now starts on the one an admin chose instead of the Anthropic-hosted default
[Remote Control] Fixed the next message to an idle session going unanswered after you restart `claude remote-control`, when you sent it within a minute of your previous message
[Claude Tag] Changed newly pasted artifact links in Slack to show a simpler card with an Open button that opens the artifact in Claude, instead of Slack's side panel
`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
`managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first

`guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt

fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
`sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
`claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
`--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them
a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
`claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them
`/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window
the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound
Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows
a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved
first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals
the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine
Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined
Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list
Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow

Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each
auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts
server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused
[VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed
[VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
[VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"
[Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
[Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
[Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
[Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
[Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
[Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
[Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
[Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings
[Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count
`permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode
an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too
`guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text
idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired
sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
`claude -p` exiting with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1
Bedrock sessions with many images failing every turn and `/compact` with "400 Input is too long." instead of removing older images and compacting
Microsoft Foundry sessions failing when the resource has no deployment for the default Sonnet, Opus or Haiku model: Claude Code now falls back to an older model of that family
repeated refused requests behind a gateway that doesn't accept tool search's `tool_reference` blocks: the request is sent again once without tool search, and the session remembers
TLS connections failing with `UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT` when the system certificate store holds a renewed root certificate that is cross-signed with its predecessor
MCP servers that also work without sign-in showing "needs authentication" after their stored sign-in stopped working; they are now used signed out
`claude mcp logout` reporting success when the MCP sign-in was not removed, for example while the macOS keychain is locked over SSH
extra sign-in renewals when several sessions share an Anthropic profile login and the credentials lock is busy
`claude ultrareview` and `claude remote-control` asking the workspace trust question in a CI job that has a terminal; with `CI` set they now refuse an untrusted folder at once
an administrator's TLS trust settings in managed settings not being applied in Claude Desktop sessions
model switching being refused on machines with managed plugin settings when one of your own `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` plugins had a broken manifest or failed to download
the Bedrock and Vertex model upgrade offer coming back at every start when managed settings pin the model
`forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` set only in remote managed settings no longer applying once the stored copy had expired, which let sessions start without policy when the server could not be reached

quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without its `>` markers

a line on stderr, when it is a terminal, that says what a `claude -p` run is waiting for when it stays open after its last turn

support for `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` on the Claude apps gateway's Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other cloud upstreams: a value you set now limits how long a stream may take to start there, after which it fails over or gets a 502
a "Backgrounding cancelled" message when you stop the turn while `←` is waiting for the current tool to finish

a `request-id` header to the Claude apps gateway's successful inference responses, so `request_id` in Claude Code telemetry matches the gateway's audit log
every request failing on a `[1m]` model when a gateway, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry refuses the context-1m beta; Claude Code now resends without it
`claude -p` text output dropping earlier responses when background work started another turn; each turn's response now prints when the turn ends

PushNotification saying a push was not sent in `claude remote-control` sessions right after a phone message, without the `/config` toggle, or when started from inside Claude Code
files sent from remote sessions being refused as "could not be vouched for" when more than 256 were sent at once
a rare failure to load managed settings at startup right after a login refresh
`/tui` exiting without a message, or with a raw system error, when Claude Code could not be started again
a link address shown as text being hidden by a colour or conceal style a reply left on, including where it wraps in a table or a question preview

the Claude apps gateway's admin spend view showing a developer's old groups and group cap after their session stopped carrying groups

raw terminal hyperlink bytes in a reply or a teammate's message being drawn as a clickable link with a hidden address

the `/advisor` dialog showing a checkmark on a saved advisor model that is no longer available; it now opens on "No advisor"

the mod hot-reloading question being asked again every turn for the whole session when it is approved without picking an answer

bold text being drawn faint in piped output when it directly follows dim text

non-interactive sessions telling you about MCP servers that need authentication when your request doesn't use them

changing the auto-update channel in `/config` saving before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked

Improved the Claude apps gateway to log a warning every 30 seconds while its PostgreSQL database is read-only, saying what fails and how to recover

Improved the status shown in Remote Control, claude.ai and the desktop app for a session waiting on a permission prompt to name an MCP tool by its server and readable name instead of its `mcp__server__tool` identifier
Improved background requests behind a Claude apps gateway to use Haiku 4.5 instead of the session's model, falling back to the session's model where the gateway does not serve Haiku 4.5

Improved headless `rate_limit_event` usage-limit warnings to say whether the account has extra usage turned on
Improved the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: it no longer tells a session with no terminal to run terminal commands, and explains sharing a mod only when asked
Improved Grep input handling: a search sent with grep's `-l`, `-c` or `-r` flag now runs instead of failing the call

Improved what Claude is told when a large file it sends fails to upload with no reason given, so it reports the failure instead of shrinking the file

subagents to preload at most 32 skills from the `skills` field, each once; a subagent with the Skill tool can still invoke the rest

claude.ai connectors to negotiate MCP protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on installs that fetch no flags; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
Artifact pages with no background of their own to show on white instead of off-white

tab stops to count from where a text starts instead of from the screen's left edge: an answer indented by 2 has its first stop 8 cells in, where it was 6

scheduled and Run now routine runs in installs with telemetry disabled to publish new private artifacts, and update your own, without asking, as in other installs
toasts from your organization's mods to show ahead of other mods' toasts instead of waiting behind them
the Claude apps gateway to start with a warning and serve a `desktop` policy key its bundled Claude Desktop schema doesn't know, so new Desktop settings need no gateway upgrade
WebSocket (`ws`) MCP servers: a message over 16 MiB is no longer parsed and closes the connection, the limit the other transports already have

web searches and `agent` hook evaluations taking much longer at `xhigh` and `max` effort
`prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block

the footer's agents count disappearing after a momentary failure to read the sessions folder (for example, too many open files)
a custom agent named `worker` being shown as "Agent" when it starts, and the agent detail dialog's title losing the agent type once the agent finishes

hooks and SDK permission callbacks seeing a missing or outdated plan on ExitPlanMode when the plan was written in the same response

[Claude Tag] Fixed removing a GitHub organization's grant from an access bundle's Repositories tab in Claude Tag admin settings failing to save after that GitHub organization was disconnected

[Claude Tag] Fixed the cost and token totals in Claude's reply footer reading many times too high after the session's cloud worker restarted
[Claude Tag] Changed the bordered cards Claude uses in Slack replies for plans, tables and details to render wide by default instead of a narrow width
[Claude Tag] Changed newly connected Slack workspaces to follow the current default model instead of keeping whichever model was the default when they were connected

`telemetry.resource_attributes` to the Claude apps gateway config, to put fixed labels on the telemetry of Claude Desktop and `/login` sessions
`"attribution": false` in `settings.json` to hide all commit and PR attribution; older CLI versions skip a settings file that holds it, so keep the object form in files shared across versions

MCP server checks to `claude plugin validate`: it reports `.mcp.json` entries that would be silently dropped at load, undeclared `${user_config.*}` references, and insecure URLs
an auto mode recommendation to `/insights` that estimates how many permission prompts auto mode could have handled in your recent sessions
a scrollbar to the `/skills`, `/mcp` and `/plugin` Installed lists in fullscreen mode, like the one `/workflows` now has: it appears while the mouse is over the list and can be clicked or dragged
a crash ("unrecoverable interface error") that could end a session while an API request was being retried
a turn that could retry indefinitely, ignoring `--max-turns`, when the model alternated unparseable tool calls and output-limit truncation

resumed sessions re-sending earlier turns in a changed form (a parallel tool-call turn, an MCP tool call's input or a tool-search result while its server was still reconnecting, or a tool-search result whose loading turn was interrupted), which could make the API drop the conversation's prior reasoning
resuming a very large session sometimes restoring only its last few messages
a session resumed after a restart during a pending permission prompt sending a different history than before, which broke the prompt cache from that point
resuming a session that ended during a tool call: Claude now sees the call and is told its outcome is unknown, and a manual resume no longer adds a hidden "Continue" message
sessions with an earlier advisor result the API could no longer read failing one request every turn and repeatedly losing earlier reasoning; the history is now repaired once
the prompt cache being lost when an MCP server disconnects mid-conversation, or is still connecting after a resume, while tool search is off (for example behind a proxy or gateway)
responses cut short by a proxy or gateway that closes the stream cleanly being shown as complete with no warning, and tool calls running twice on duplicated stream events
responses failing with "Content block not found" when a proxy drops a stream event mid-response; the partial response is now kept, and web search keeps results that already arrived
an empty completed response being requested twice when the connection dropped before the stream's final event
the stop reason being lost when a proxy sends a trailing usage-only frame
`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` sessions failing on the first 5xx or dropped connection after a run of 429/529 waits, and sleeping uncapped and silently on a long `Retry-After` from a 5xx
fast mode retrying rate-limited requests back to back when the server sent `Retry-After: 0`
a tool that returned an oversized image leaving sibling tool calls unanswered and still running, or ending the turn with no final message
conversations getting permanently stuck on "tool_use.name: String should have at most 200 characters" after the model called a tool by an overlong name

tool calls failing with "Failed to get memory usage", or being reported as failed after they ran, when Claude Code cannot read its own memory usage, for example when it has run out of file descriptors
`--input-format stream-json` sessions (Agent SDK, VS Code extension) and scheduled cloud sessions failing every turn with an error when an earlier assistant message had plain-string content
non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) failing on the next turn after the directory they were started in was deleted mid-session
headless sessions with host-side (SDK) MCP servers stalling on the first message when the host stops responding mid-handshake; remote sessions now wait a few seconds at most
interactive startup waiting on the managed-settings network request (about 80 ms, 17+ seconds when the network is unreachable) when no MCP servers or plugins are configured
a delay of up to two minutes before responding when reading or @-mentioning a PDF larger than 3 MB
an interrupted Read of specific PDF pages leaving its page render running for up to two minutes
permission dialogs and attachment checks reading a path under macOS's `/.vol`, `/.nofollow` or `/.resolve` (which can reach a network mount) before approval

a recursive `rm` whose target is only command-substitution output, such as `rm -rf "$(pwd)"`, running unprompted in auto and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` mode; it now asks even with a Bash allow rule, unless run with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SUBSTITUTION_RM_PROMPT=1`
a permission rule containing a NUL byte being expanded into a wildcard match; such a rule now matches nothing
sandbox `excludedCommands` entries not matching `git rev-parse --git-dir`, programs named like shell builtins, and commit messages containing `[WIP]` or `#` lines
sandboxed Bash commands being unable to write to `$TMPDIR` when `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` is set

`claude --bg` starting a background session, and running its project hooks, in a directory that had not passed the workspace trust prompt; it now asks for trust first, or exits when not run interactively
`--setting-sources` (and SDK `settingSources`) not being forwarded to spawned sessions: teammates, `/bg`, `claude agents` sessions and `--worktree --tmux` now start with the parent's restriction
Read, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit: a file path containing a null byte now fails that tool call with a clear error instead of ending the whole turn
Write refusing a call that gives the file path or content twice under two parameter names with identical values
CLAUDE.md and rules files from an `--add-dir` directory inside the working directory being sent to the model twice in headless and SDK sessions
remote sessions staying on "needs approval" with a stale prompt after a permission prompt and a sandbox network-access prompt overlapped and both were answered
cloud sessions not telling Claude about background agents that finished just before a worker restart
scheduled routine and notification turns in remote sessions not receiving turn-start notices (newly available tools, MCP changes, date, todos) until after the first tool call
scheduled tasks and `/loop` wakeups being fired again every second when their delivery failed, which could make Claude Code exit at the end of a turn
Remote Control reporting "disabled by your organization's policy" when the org policy simply hadn't loaded yet; it now retries the fetch and says it couldn't verify
the Artifact tool missing from Remote Control sessions that `claude remote-control` starts for you to open from Claude Desktop, claude.ai or the mobile app
macOS credential writes dropping stored MCP OAuth tokens or deleting the keychain entry when the login keychain was locked (e.g. right after wake)
`gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh` login processes being left running (and holding their localhost callback port on Windows) when Claude Code exits or the refresh times out
the "Not logged in · Run /login" footer and missing claude.ai connectors persisting in a session after logging in from another Claude Code process
`mcp_tool` hooks on blocking events (PreToolUse and similar) being skipped while their MCP server was still connecting; they now wait for it, up to the MCP connect timeout
the same MCP server being connected twice when a plugin or claude.ai connector and a configured server spell its URL differently (host letter case, default port, trailing slash)
`MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0` giving up on claude.ai connectors after 1s instead of honoring `MCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`
`--channels` plugin entries being checked against the installed plugin's marketplace alone; the installed plugin's name must now match the entry as well
`--plugin-dir` on a folder of plugins that also has a `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` loading one empty plugin instead of the plugins in it
`claude plugin uninstall` refusing to remove a project-scope plugin that isn't enabled, saying it is "enabled at project scope" while `claude plugin disable` says it is already disabled
`claude plugin update` failing for project-scoped plugins when `--scope` is omitted — it now resolves the scope the plugin is installed at instead of assuming user
`claude plugin validate` reporting `privacyPolicyUrl`, `supportUrl` and other listing metadata keys in plugin.json as unknown fields
`known_marketplaces.json` recording a marketplace as refreshed when its remote could not be reached and `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE` kept the existing clone
the `/plugin` Errors tab showing no confirmation after its last error is resolved
`/plugin` starting a second uninstall or update of the same plugin when Enter was pressed again while the first was still running
a `y` held while `/plugin` checks a marketplace source adding the marketplace the instant the "Add marketplace?" question appears, before it can be read
`1` answering Yes in `/permissions`' delete and remove-directory confirms while the pointer is on No, which let a held `1` remove one workspace directory after another
Alt+T and `/config` offering to turn thinking off on models that can't; thinking now stays on there, with a one-line reason in place of the switch
`/context` total leaving out messages added since the last response; it now matches its categories and can read higher than the status line
`/model` showing the raw API error JSON and request ID when the API refuses the picked model; it now shows the server's message and says the model was not changed

API errors from an HTML error page (such as a proxy's 429 or 502 page) printing the page's raw markup or leaving out the HTTP status, and error messages breaking onto a second line when the server's error text ended in a newline
/feedback, /bug and /share still sending your report after you cancelled it while it was being sent
/feedback, /bug and /share failing every send with "Couldn't send feedback" after a Remote Control Stop arrived while the dialog was open
`/ide` showing "No available IDEs detected" while also listing a running IDE
the terminal being left in a broken state (crash or garbled input) when `/setup-bedrock` or `/setup-vertex` restarts Claude Code to apply new settings
`/config` exiting when `respectGitignore` or `copyFullResponse` in `~/.claude.json` holds `null`
the session name from /rename disappearing while Claude asks a multiple-choice question, so side-by-side sessions stay identifiable
one-line pastes showing on their own lines in the sent message for prompts from VS Code or Remote Control and for expanded paste placeholders
a message queued while Claude is working losing or changing the IDE selection it was written with, and queued messages not showing their selection
pressing Shift+Tab twice quickly landing on the wrong permission mode

Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D pressed twice quitting Claude Code instead of closing the dialog in the remaining dialogs and pickers, such as `/memory`, `/hooks`, `/mcp` (including a server's sign-in screen), `/export`, `/copy`, `/theme`, and `/teleport`'s uncommitted-changes and login prompts (where Esc also quit)

keys that arrive in one burst of input (e.g. over Remote Control), such as an arrow key followed by Enter, `x` or `s`, acting on the previous selection: a stale effort level in `/effort` and the model picker, and the previously highlighted row in `/skills`, the background task rows under the prompt, MCP server prompts and `/install-github-app`

`/install-github-app` updating the workflow after "Skip workflow update" was chosen, running setup twice on a repeated Enter, and ↑ on the repository step blocking a typed repository name when no repository was detected

vim mode: `dj`/`dk`/`dG`/`dgg` and their `c`/`y` forms acting on part of a line; `1G` going to the last line; `d0`/`c0`/`y0` doing nothing; the cursor being off by one after `.` repeats an insert; and `o`/`p` on a `!`-prefixed line switching to shell mode

the prompt cursor moving one character too far after an accent typed as its own key
an extra blank line above a list item whose text starts on the line after its bullet, in screen-reader mode, quoted lists and long lists
bulleted lists of plain numbers (like `- 316.`) showing as letters, roman numerals or the wrong numbers
the agent panel's footer hint ignoring keys rebound in `keybindings.json`, and showing a stray ` · ` when the stop-all-agents shortcut is unbound
the agent panel footer offering "Enter to view" and "x to stop" on the agent you are already viewing (where x types into its input), and "Enter to view" on the main row when main is already shown
a mouse click on an agent-panel row leaving the keyboard cursor on the previously selected row
Esc interrupting the running turn instead of deselecting the selected agent-panel row
PgUp and PgDn doing nothing in a dialog's list (for example `/skills`) in fullscreen mode
`/heapdump` summary saying most memory is native when it is in the JS heap snapshot
Bash edit-diff snapshot directories piling up in the temp folder: abandoned ones are now deleted right away and the rest when Claude Code exits
/workflows moving the pointer to a different run, and `x` stopping it, when a new run started while the list was open
the selected tab in tabbed dialogs (`/config`, `/plugin`, `/permissions`) showing no highlight while the tab bar has focus when color is off (`NO_COLOR`)
the mouse wheel over the `/plugin` Installed list scrolling the pane behind it instead of the list
the hover highlight lingering on a list row in fullscreen mode after scrolling or filtering moved it away from the mouse
long list rows, such as in the /remote-control menu, wrapping onto a second line in narrow terminals; they're now cut with …

lists such as a skill's state options in `/plugin` not being answerable by typing a number in screen-reader mode
Windows: Fixed Bash commands that write to `$TMPDIR/…` failing with "Permission denied"
Windows: Fixed a race in which Claude Code sessions updating at the same moment could delete each other's `claude.exe` backup, which could leave no `claude.exe` behind
Improved Claude Desktop sign-in and usage-limit error messages to point at the app instead of terminal commands
Improved startup: managed settings and policy fetches no longer retry requests that can never succeed
Improved interactive startup time: git reads, startup telemetry and the Bedrock/Vertex model-upgrade checks no longer run before the first frame
Improved the time to resume long sessions that read many files; the restored file cache now matches the files as they were read
Improved the time to resume very long sessions that have been compacted, most noticeably through the Agent SDK and Claude Desktop
Improved "Prompt is too long" recovery in sessions dominated by one very large first prompt: that prompt is now summarized on its own instead of being left out of the summary

Improved the auto mode denial message so Claude treats a denial as covering the outcome, not only the exact command
Improved the dangerous-rm check to also flag a removal at a shell variable followed by a top-level directory name, at a variable derived from the working directory, or at a backslash-only target

Improved debug logs to name settings `env` variables ignored because the session's launch environment already sets them

Improved the `/workflows` and `/mcp` lists: they page (PgUp/PgDn, Home/End) and take j/k and the mouse like other lists, their arrows follow `select:previous`/`select:next` rebinds, and `x` in `/workflows` stops the run the pointer is on

Improved the /plugin Installed list: rows now line up in columns (status, name, type, details) across every section
Improved `/skills`: each row now leads with the skill's name, with ✔ or ◯ alone showing on or off, and stays on one line in narrow terminals
Improved narrow list rows (`/skills`, `/workflows`, `/feedback`): a name keeps 20 columns beside its first detail, and details are shown whole or not at all
Improved `/diff`: a scrollbar shows where you are in a long list of changed files, and long paths no longer wrap their rows

Improved screen-reader output in `/mcp`: a disabled server is read as "off" instead of "pending"

send now (ctrl+enter or ctrl+x ctrl+s) to move running tools to the background instead of cancelling the turn
auto mode so that, where its classifier review runs server-side, read-only and sandboxed shell commands also wait for that review and are blocked when it flags them

the dangerous `rm` prompt in `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and auto mode to wait 2 minutes for an answer, then deny the command with a rewrite hint so unattended sessions keep going (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT=1` turns this off)
AGENTS.md support to also work on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry, LLM gateways, and sessions with telemetry disabled

queued messages to show in the conversation above the spinner instead of under it

Improved fullscreen mode: adding or removing a prompt line (Shift+Enter) now repaints as fast as typing a character instead of re-rendering the visible transcript
Improved `--continue` / `--resume`: the conversation appears immediately instead of waiting for SessionStart hooks, and the first message no longer re-reads the whole transcript
Improved responsiveness during tool-heavy turns by no longer redrawing the transcript for a hidden per-tool-batch reminder
Improved startup time in projects with `.claude/workflows/` scripts: listing them no longer parses each script
Improved auto mode denials: the message Claude receives now names the rule that blocked the action and asks Claude to try a safer method and finish unrelated work before stopping to ask you
Improved Claude in Chrome: long page reads now stay inline instead of being saved to a file and read back
Improved the MEMORY.md truncation warning to say how many lines were cut and where the cut starts
Improved the terminal permission prompt for artifacts: it now leads with the ask's question
Improved the prompt footer: an editor or `/diff` selection now shows inside the prompt input, and fullscreen mode shows Remote Control status in the header instead of the footer
Improved the "Usage credits required for 1M context" message to say that usage credits turned on mid-session take effect after restarting Claude Code
Improved `/plugin`: installing, enabling or disabling a plugin now takes effect when you close the menu; `/reload-plugins` is no longer needed afterwards
the system prompt on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to deliver environment, model and settings details as attachments, matching first-party sessions
Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry sessions to keep the tool list byte-stable across a conversation (late-connecting tools load deferred instead of rewriting it), matching first-party sessions
the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) to be offered only on Claude 3.x, Opus 4.0–4.7, Sonnet 4.0–4.6, Haiku 4.5; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` elsewhere
the artifact data-edit permission prompt in the terminal to a card that shows the document count and who can open the artifact
local Cowork sessions set to skip all approvals: the Artifact tool now refuses a local file outside the session's folders, or behind a symlink, instead of reading it without asking
plain `WebFetch` deny and ask rules to no longer apply to Artifact tool reads and updates; use an `Artifact` rule (or `WebFetch(domain:claude.ai)`) to block or gate them
the "N MCP servers need authentication" startup notice to announce each server once instead of at every launch

[VSCode] Added Left and Right arrow keys to change where an always-allow permission rule is saved, for keyboard and screen reader users

[VSCode] Changed the Manage plugins dialog to apply installs, enables, disables and uninstalls to open sessions without a restart
[VSCode] Changed some artifact permission prompts to omit the "don't ask again" choice, matching the terminal
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed cloud sessions running longer than about six hours silently losing files saved to persisted session folders; saves now persist for up to a day
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed "Invalid effort level" errors when a routine resumes a session, or a session starts with no set effort, in orgs where an admin caps a model's effort

[Claude Tag] Fixed the admin settings page hanging on a loading skeleton or going blank after a transient load failure; a section that fails to load now shows a Retry button
[Claude Tag] Added a link from a Slack channel's configure page back to the organization's Claude in Slack admin settings
[Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack Enterprise Grid channel losing its Claude settings (repository, environment, access) after a Slack admin moved it to another workspace
[Claude Tag] Improved how Claude explains a blocked action: it now says whether a permission check, its own decision to confirm first, or missing access stopped it
[Claude Tag] Improved reply speed: Claude now runs several read-only lookups (searching Slack, reading a thread, finding people) at once instead of one after another
[Claude Tag] Improved formatting of comparisons: sentence-length comparisons now come as lists instead of wide tables that scroll sideways, and long table cells wrap
[Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` in a thread with its own session sometimes also posting a contradictory "this thread is handled by the channel session" notice
[Claude Tag] Improved the message shown when your Claude account is in a different organization than the Slack workspace: it now explains how to connect the workspace to your org
[Claude Tag] Fixed Markdown links whose URL is wrapped in angle brackets showing as literal bracket text in Slack instead of a clickable link
[Claude Tag] Fixed a workspace guest's top-level @mention in a channel where guests may use Claude sometimes getting a "your Slack account isn't connected" reply instead of an answer
[Claude Tag] Fixed a channel's long-running session being replaced with a fresh one mid-conversation; the scheduled refresh now waits until the channel and its threads are quiet
[Claude Tag] Fixed channel-settings cards clicked more than once telling the proposing session the change was refused after it had already applied; the outcome is now sent once
[Claude Tag] Changed memory in public channels: each channel now keeps its own notes, and Claude no longer recalls notes it saved in other public channels; workspace notes stay shared
[Code Review] Added a note under the still-open findings list in follow-up reviews: resolving a finding's thread, not just replying to it, stops later reviews from counting it as open
[Code Review] Fixed reviews sometimes ending as incomplete when one of the agents verifying a finding failed midway; the review now replaces that agent and reaches a verdict
[Code Review] Fixed a push-triggered review that was queued behind a running review still posting after the pull request had been converted to draft
[Code Review] Fixed reviews ignoring a directory's CLAUDE.md conventions when the PR edited a root file (e.g. README.md) that only shares a name with a file that CLAUDE.md lists
`maxEffortLevel` setting (top-level or per model under `modelSettings`): caps the effort level on every provider, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; users can still pick a lower level
`--system-prompt-snapshot off` to render the system prompt fresh on every request instead of reusing the conversation's recorded prompt (for iterating on prompt text)

`/context` and other local command output rendering blank on mobile clients
shift+enter and option+backspace not working after reconnecting to a tmux or ssh session inside an agent view
the dim last-prompt header not appearing at the top of the conversation when scrolling up in fullscreen mode

a case where a marketplace entry path containing a backslash could bypass the containment check for fetched marketplaces on macOS and Linux
expired AWS or Google Cloud credentials under a host app such as Claude Desktop retrying ten times with a generic "request failed" before the re-authenticate error appeared
resuming a session after `/compact` or another slash command ran via `-p --resume`: a spurious "Continue from where you left off." turn is no longer inserted

managed `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` and `allowedChannelPlugins` to admit nothing, not everything, when unreadable

`effort:` frontmatter on custom commands, skills, and subagents being ignored on models whose default effort is still pinned (Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8, Fable 5)
artifact publish failing with an unhelpful error when the page file isn't valid UTF-8 or contains a replacement character (U+FFFD); the error now names the line and column to fix
`claude agents` `@` directory menu not listing repositories created after the session started
Remote Control clients that join a Claude Desktop or VS Code session showing a stale permission mode until it was changed again

the usage-limit warning flickering on and off during a session when requests for different models or modes report different limit windows
earlier reasoning being dropped when an MCP server re-sends, or a built-in tool re-renders, a tool the model already loaded
a tool that disappears mid-conversation, from a disconnected MCP server or an upgrade, rewriting the tool list and discarding earlier thinking

mid-session MCP and plugin tools being added to the tool list in sessions without ToolSearch, which broke prompt-cache reuse; supported models now receive them as deferred definitions
switching models with /model re-sending every tool definition (a prompt-cache miss); commit and PR attribution text now arrives as a conversation note that updates on model changes
resumed sessions rewriting the inline tool set when an MCP connector reconnects at a different moment than before
resumed sessions re-rendering tool descriptions instead of replaying the recorded ones when the first turn ran a tool
prompt-cache misses and dropped extended thinking when a claude.ai connector's tools change between a session and its resume
resumed sessions rewriting earlier MCP tool announcements (and dropping extended thinking) before their connectors reconnect
a prompt-cache break when a print-mode (`-p`) conversation is resumed interactively: the system prompt prefix no longer changes
Improved the `/diff` panel: it no longer flashes "0 files changed" and a spinner before settling, and its empty state is centered in the panel
Improved the Bash tool's description guidance so Claude describes what a command does in plain words instead of echoing the command
Improved sandbox guidance so Claude suggests `/copy` when clipboard commands such as `pbcopy` fail inside the sandbox
Improved `--resume` first-render time for sessions with many Bash tool calls
Improved prompt input responsiveness: keystrokes no longer occasionally wait a frame behind spinner or streaming repaints
Improved prompt-cache stability: subagents and sessions started with `--system-prompt` or `--append-system-prompt` now record the system prompt and tool definitions once instead of re-rendering them
Improved Artifact tool publish errors: when a publish is refused, the message now says why and what to do about it
Self-hosted runner: Changed `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` to be reported to the server at registration and to print a warning for each session that still clones through the legacy git proxy
Gateway: Changed `forward_user_identity` upstreams to return a 429 as-is to a developer whose email was forwarded, instead of failing over to the next upstream, so the proxy's per-user limits hold

[VSCode] Fixed pasting a screenshot on WSL2/WSLg inserting raw image bytes into the chat input; the image is now attached when the clipboard provides it, otherwise the paste is ignored
[VSCode] Fixed chat diff blocks always rendering with a dark editor theme; they now follow the active VS Code color theme, including high contrast
[VSCode] Fixed mixed right-to-left and English text rendering in the wrong order while typing in the message input

[VSCode] Fixed @-mentions dropping files whose paths contain spaces
[VSCode] Fixed the sessions list view failing to load in windows connected over Remote-SSH when the workspace folder exists only on the remote host
[VSCode] Fixed runaway ripgrep processes when viewing files in large or symlink-heavy workspaces
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed GitHub Enterprise Server sessions showing your GitHub account as disconnected once its token expired; PR and issue operations now refresh it automatically
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls failing in organizations without the Claude GitHub App; they now use your connected GitHub account and say so when none is connected
[Claude Tag] Added a "Use a custom connector" link to the preset connection forms in Claude Tag admin settings, so you can switch to a custom connection without starting over
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude replying "The API rejected the request as invalid" when the organization has run out of usage credits; the reply now says so and explains how to add more
[Claude Tag] Fixed thread requests to edit or delete a message Claude posted at the channel's top level being answered with a correction instead of reaching the session that posted it

a 2.1.265 regression affecting LLM-gateway and proxy setups: the undocumented `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY` environment variable, previously ignored unless `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were both set, began forcing Cloud-gateway sign-in on its own in 2.1.265, so configurations that set it alongside an API key, `apiKeyHelper`, or custom auth headers failed every request with "Not signed in to the Cloud gateway". The variable on its own is ignored again; no configuration change is needed
`user.email` and `user.groups` to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway, matching terminal sessions
support for pointing `--plugin-dir` at a folder of plugins: each child folder with a manifest loads, and children added or removed while running are picked up
a 1 GB cap on tool results saved to disk; the in-conversation preview says when a saved file was truncated

resume after the previous process died while a tool was running: the last prompt is no longer rewritten, and the interrupted tool call is kept and marked interrupted
`/model opusplan[1m]` being rejected with "Model not found"
syntax-highlighted code in permission prompts and messages sometimes omitting a character after a Ruby `?`, Erlang `$`, or Perl `$` sigil
the fullscreen transcript jumping by one row whenever the slash-command or @-file suggestion list opened or closed
a plugin path containing a backslash bypassing the symlink containment check on macOS and Linux
plugin directories whose names begin with two dots being wrongly refused as outside the plugin root

background (`--bg`) sessions occasionally being retired mid-turn when a message arrived just before the idle timeout

the advisor tool and its instructions being re-decided per request from the request's model; the decision is now made once and announced in the conversation when it changes

forked skills (`context: fork`) not streaming their kickoff prompt and, with `--forward-subagent-text`, their text turns as progress events in stream-json

the Claude apps gateway's OTLP telemetry relay pausing all forwarding to a collector for 30 seconds after it rejected a few payloads as malformed or too large
`/plugin` Discover/Browse and `claude plugin list --json --available` showing no description or display name for marketplace plugins whose metadata lives only in their `plugin.json`
`/login` showing "no gateway URL is configured" when re-run in a session that signed in to a Claude apps gateway set by managed settings
`/model` claiming a model was "saved as your default" when the settings file couldn't be written; it now says the save failed and why
`/clear` from Remote Control waiting on SessionStart hooks and on open terminal dialogs before completing
the `/config` dialog changing height when switching between its tabs
resuming a workflow run after its container restarted; a resume whose run journal is missing now fails with a clear error instead of rerunning every agent
the `claude-api` skill's error-code reference: model access failures return 404 and unavailable beta headers return 400, not 403
non-interactive sessions (`-p` with stream-json input, Agent SDK, cloud sessions) resetting the shell working directory at each new user message; a `cd` now persists across turns

some claude.ai connectors in cloud sessions showing as needing authentication even though they are connected in claude.ai (servers that answer an unsupported request with HTTP 401)
remote sessions keeping their sandbox container alive while a connector approval or sign-in link waits for you
resumed sessions showing long model-facing recovery instructions in "background task didn't finish" notices instead of a short status line
Windows: Fixed Read, Write and Edit refusing every file ("symlink resolution changed after permission was checked") when running inside an AppContainer or restricted-token sandbox

Improved the time to resume long sessions that read many files
